description: Share of 30d with no gating eval case failed in the latest eval window. This is a quality objective, not availability. One failure keeps its monitor red for a week, about 23% of the window, so a single failed eval breaches the 90% target. No data counts as up: agent_evals.scheduled_run.* watches whether runs happen. RC1-683.
name: POC Benchmark Agent — eval quality held
